description:

* Assist senior to deliver training to partners on products solution.
* Contribute to and refine technical RFP and RFI responses.
* Support customer demonstrations and presentations
* Coordinating and managing technical validation events (POC)

**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**

* Able to perform basic mathematical calculations.
* Able to communicate clearly and convey necessary information.
* Able to adjust readily to change and adapt as needed.
* Able to quickly learn/adapt to new systems and technology.

* Professional, office environment.

At Tech Data, a TD SYNNEX Company, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.

title: STSI Ahmedabad (SSMT)
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Sales
  
  
Our Sales teams help to deliver Reckitt's purpose by building shared success with our customers, making access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment possible in-stores and online. Within Sales, we're focused on achieving outperformance across all of our channels, operating in highly competitive categories. This focus results in a dynamic, fast paced environment where cross functional teams are encouraged to collaborate to achieve success. We have around 10,000 sales people across the world, within market roles and ranging in areas like Field Sales, Key Accounts, Trade Marketing and Category Development.
  
  
**About The Role**
Embark on a fulfilling journey as a Pharmaceutical Sales Representative with Reckitt. In this position, you'll harness your passion for the healthcare field to introduce life-enhancing pharmaceutical products to professionals who care for patients every day. Armed with a deep understanding of our products and the compassion to make a difference, you'll be the bridge between our breakthrough solutions and the healthcare community. Join us and channel your drive into a career that helps improve lives.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Be the go-to expert for product knowledge, providing insightful information on our pharmaceutical range and its application in therapy areas.
* Meet and exceed sales targets, ensuring Reckitt's pharmaceutical products reach the hands of healthcare providers.
* Develop lasting relationships with healthcare professionals, becoming a reliable source of expertise and support.
* Convey the benefits of our pharmaceutical products through engaging and informative presentations.
* Analyse market data to stay ahead of industry trends, identifying growth opportunities and delivering on them.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* A track record of success in pharmaceutical sales.
* A deep understanding of medical terminologies, products, and therapeutic areas.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to connect and influence healthcare professionals.
* A proactive approach to building and nurturing relationships with a diverse range of medical authorities.
* Committed to ethical practises and familiar with the regulatory landscape of the pharmaceutical industry.

The skills for success
  
  
Sales Targets, product Knowledge, Customer Relationships, Product Presentations, Market Analysis, Compliance, Territory Management, Training and Development, Sales Reporting, Collaboration.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

E

title: Functional Consultant Business Central
description:
**Responsibilities**

•   Run requirement workshops with manufacturing clients: production, planning, stores, costing and finance teams.

•   Prepare fit-gap analyses that separate standard BC, AppSource add-ons and custom AL development.

•   Design and configure BC manufacturing: production BOMs and versions, routings, work and machine centers, capacity calendars and production order flows.

•   Set up planning (MPS/MRP, planning worksheet, reordering policies, safety stock, lead times) and explain planning results to client users.

•   Configure inventory costing, overheads and variance analysis, and reconcile manufacturing postings to the general ledger.

•   Configure related areas as needed: assembly orders, subcontracting, item tracking, warehouse picks for production.

•   Plan and validate data migration for items, BOMs, routings and opening stock.

•   Write functional specifications for our AL developers and test what they deliver.

•   Prepare UAT scripts, train client key users and support go-live and hypercare.

•   Coach and review the work of Latitude's junior functional consultants.

•   Help build our toolkit: manufacturing discovery questionnaire, fit-gap template, migration templates and a demo company.

**Must have**

**Manufacturing implementation experience is mandatory. Applications without it will not be considered.**

•   5+ years as a functional consultant on Business Central or Dynamics NAV.

•   At least 2 end-to-end manufacturing implementations taken live in BC or NAV, with your role in each clearly stated.

•   Hands-on configuration of production BOMs, routings, work/machine centers and the full production order lifecycle.

•   Working knowledge of MRP/MPS in BC and of why the planning worksheet suggests what it does.

•   Solid understanding of manufacturing costing in BC: standard, FIFO and average costing, overheads, variances and cost adjustment.

•   Ability to run client workshops and write clear functional specifications in English.

•   Experience with BC SaaS (cloud), not only on-premises NAV.

**Nice to have**

•   Microsoft certification MB-800 (Business Central Functional Consultant Associate).

•   Background as a production, planning or cost accountant in a manufacturing company before consulting.

•   Experience with Indian manufacturers and BC India localization (GST, TDS, e-invoicing).

•   Experience with manufacturing add-ons from AppSource (process manufacturing, quality control, shop-floor data capture, scheduling).

•   Exposure to warehouse management (directed put-away and pick) for production.

•   Experience with Copilot or agent features in Business Central.

•   Hindi or Gujarati, for workshops with shop-floor staff in Gujarat.

title: Tender Executive
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive
**Tender Executive**
to identify relevant government and private-sector tenders, prepare and submit bids, and manage e-procurement portals. The candidate will be responsible for tracking tender opportunities related to e-waste recycling, waste management, scrap disposal, EPR compliance, reverse logistics, and environmental services.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have prior experience in tender management, bid documentation, government procurement portals, and online tender submission processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Tender Identification and Monitoring
* Regularly monitor government and public-sector tender portals, including GeM (Government e-Marketplace), CPPP, state e-procurement portals, and relevant private-sector platforms.
* Identify suitable tender opportunities related to e-waste collection, recycling, disposal, EPR compliance, scrap disposal, reverse logistics, and waste management.
* Evaluate tender eligibility, scope of work, submission deadlines, Earnest Money Deposit (EMD), tender fees, turnover requirements, experience criteria, and technical specifications.
* Maintain a structured tender tracker covering upcoming, active, submitted, and awarded tenders.
* Track tender amendments, corrigenda, pre-bid meetings, and deadline extensions.
* Tender Documentation and Bid Preparation
* Prepare and compile technical bids, financial bids, commercial proposals, and supporting documentation.
* Draft covering letters, declarations, undertakings, compliance statements, and other documents required by tendering authorities.
* Coordinate the collection and verification of company documents, including GST registration, PAN, CIN, audited financial statements, turnover certificates, work orders, experience certificates, and statutory records.
* Review tender conditions and ensure that all eligibility and documentation requirements are fulfilled before submission.
* Identify deviations, risks, missing documents, and compliance gaps, and escalate them to the concerned team before bid submission.
* Coordinate with internal departments to obtain technical, financial, and operational information required for preparing competitive bids.
* E-Procurement Portal Management
* Register and maintain company profiles on GeM, CPPP, state e-procurement portals, and other relevant procurement platforms.
* Manage Digital Signature Certificates (DSCs) and portal credentials securely.
* Upload tender documents, submit online bids, and complete all required e-procurement formalities within prescribed deadlines.
* Monitor portal notifications, technical clarifications, bid opening updates, and submission acknowledgements.
* Maintain organized records of tender documents, submission receipts, bid status, and related correspondence.
* Tender Pipeline and Reporting
* Maintain an updated database of tender opportunities, eligibility status, submission timelines, and outcomes.
* Prepare periodic reports on tenders identified, bids submitted, pending actions, and tenders awarded or rejected.
* Coordinate with management to prioritize suitable opportunities based on eligibility, commercial viability, and business requirements.
* Follow up on tender results, requests for clarification, technical evaluations, and financial bid openings.
* Maintain a systematic digital repository of tender-related documents for future reference.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in tender management, bid coordination, or e-procurement operations.
* Practical knowledge of GeM, CPPP, and/or state government e-procurement portals.
* Experience in preparing technical bids, financial bids, compliance documents, and commercial proposals.
* Understanding of tender eligibility criteria, EMD, tender fees, turnover requirements, and bid submission procedures.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, and document management.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation, coordination, and deadline management.
* Good written communication skills and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external authorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience handling tenders related to e-waste recycling, scrap disposal, waste management, environmental services, or reverse logistics.
* Familiarity with EPR compliance, CPCB requirements, and relevant waste management regulations.
* Experience with government departments, PSUs, municipal corporations, industrial organizations, or institutional procurement.
* Knowledge of DSC-based online bid submission and tender portal registrations.

Skills: e-procurement,government e-procurement portals,tender compliance,tender management,tender fee management,cppp,bid preparation,financial bids,gem,tender documentation

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Role Purpose

MachineAstro is looking for a commercially driven Key Account Manager responsible for growing strategic industrial accounts through customer value creation, new opportunity hunting, use-case development, account expansion and revenue growth. The role combines consultative selling with strong technical understanding of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring and asset health. The KAM will work across plant, corporate, technical, procurement and senior-management stakeholders and convert customer problems into measurable business outcomes and sustainable revenue.

 Key Responsibilities1. Strategic Key Account Ownership

·      Own assigned strategic accounts and prepare account plans covering customer priorities, installed base, stakeholders, whitespace, opportunities, risks and growth actions.

·      Build multi-level relationships across maintenance, reliability, engineering, operations, digital/IT, procurement and senior management.

·      Understand customer operations, asset criticality, maintenance practices and business priorities to identify areas where MachineAstro can create value.

2. Account Growth & Expansion

·      Drive year-on-year growth within existing accounts through cross-sell, upsell, additional assets, plants, business units, applications and services.

·      Identify whitespace and increase MachineAstro share of wallet by expanding successful deployments from machine/area level to line, plant, multi-site or enterprise programs.

·      Convert successful POCs, pilots and initial deployments into repeat and larger commercial programs.

3. Opportunity & Use-Case Hunting

·      Proactively identify new customer problems, reliability gaps and business cases rather than relying only on inbound enquiries or RFQs.

·      Identify opportunities related to recurring failures, unplanned downtime, maintenance cost, inspection effort, safety, critical rotating equipment and predictive-maintenance initiatives.

·      Develop new use cases and convert identified pain points into qualified opportunities with clear technical, commercial and value propositions.

·      Maintain strong focus on pipeline creation, opportunity quality and conversion.

4. Value Creation & Consultative Selling

·      Position MachineAstro as a reliability and technology partner, linking solutions to measurable customer outcomes.

·      Develop ROI/value cases around downtime avoidance, maintenance cost reduction, asset availability, reliability, safety and productivity.

·      Work with SMEs and presales to quantify value, develop solution proposals and demonstrate business impact.

·      Capture successful outcomes and replicate proven value propositions across similar accounts or plants.

5. Customer Engagement, POC & Solution Execution

·      Conduct regular customer plant visits, asset assessments, POC discussions, technical workshops, demonstrations, reviews and training.

·      Lead customer-facing POCs with clear objectives, success criteria, timelines and commercial conversion plans.

·      Coordinate project planning and delivery from the account perspective, ensuring commitments and customer expectations are met.

·      Identify expansion opportunities during and immediately after implementation.

6. Technical & Fault-Analysis Coordination

·      Understand vibration and condition-monitoring concepts and customer asset failure modes sufficiently to lead technical-commercial discussions.

·      Coordinate with CAT-II/CAT-III analysts and SMEs for asset fault analysis, recommendations and data-driven customer insights.

·      Translate technical findings into operational impact, business value and recommended next actions.

7. Customer Success & Retention

·      Ensure customers realize measurable value from deployed solutions and maintain high levels of adoption and satisfaction.

·      Identify risks to customer satisfaction, renewal, adoption or expansion and drive timely resolution with internal teams.

·      Convert customer success into references, case studies, repeat deployments and expansion opportunities.

8. Internal & Partner Collaboration

·      Align SMEs, presales, product management, inside sales, delivery and customer-success teams around account priorities and opportunity strategy.

·      Develop productive relationships with system integrators, consultants and technology partners to create and expand opportunities.

·      Share customer requirements, market feedback and competitive intelligence with relevant internal teams.

9. Commercial Management & Payment Follow-up

·      Own commercial follow-up for assigned accounts in coordination with finance, sales operations and business teams.

·      Track purchase orders, invoicing, payment milestones, outstanding receivables and agreed credit terms.

·      Proactively follow up with customer commercial/procurement/accounts-payable teams to ensure invoices are processed and payments are received on time.

·      Escalate overdue payments, disputes and commercial risks promptly and coordinate resolution with internal stakeholders.

·      Maintain healthy receivables and ensure account growth is supported by disciplined cash collection.

10. Market Intelligence & Marketing Support

·      Track industry trends, customer priorities, competitor positioning and emerging technologies in condition monitoring, predictive maintenance and Industrial IoT.

·      Identify market intelligence that can improve MachineAstro's value proposition and opportunity strategy.

·      Support marketing with customer insights, case studies, application stories, demos, blogs, videos and success stories.

11. Revenue & Management Reporting

·      Own account-level revenue growth in collaboration with Business Development and Sales leadership.

·      Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, opportunity stages, closure plans and account-growth metrics.

·      Provide management updates on revenue, pipeline, new use cases, expansion opportunities, customer risks, collections and strategic actions.

   Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

·      Year-on-year revenue growth from assigned key accounts

·      New revenue generated from existing customers

·      Account expansion and share-of-wallet growth

·      New opportunities and qualified pipeline generated

·      New use cases / business cases developed

·      POC-to-commercial conversion rate

·      New plants, business units and assets penetrated

·      Customer retention, satisfaction and referenceability

·      Forecast accuracy and opportunity conversion

·      On-time collection / receivables performance and reduction of overdue payments

·      Strategic account-plan execution and stakeholder coverage

 Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hunter-farmer and trusted advisor who can protect and grow existing relationships while continuously discovering new customer problems, creating business value and converting opportunities into revenue. The candidate should be comfortable engaging with plant engineers as well as senior business leaders and should combine technical credibility with strong commercial ownership.

 Qualifications & Experience

·      BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering – preferred/required based on role fit

·      10+ years of relevant experience in industrial B2B sales, key account management, business development, reliability, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, industrial automation or related fields

·      CAT-II / CAT-III Vibration Certification – strongly preferred

·      MBA in Marketing, Sales, Business Management or related discipline – preferred

·      Demonstrated experience managing strategic industrial accounts and delivering account growth

·      Experience with manufacturing/process industries and technical solution selling is highly desirable

 Core Competencies

·      Strategic Key Account Management

·      Account Expansion, Cross-sell & Upsell

·      Opportunity Hunting & Consultative Selling

·      Value Selling and Business Case Development

·      Vibration / Condition Monitoring Understanding

·      Customer & Executive Stakeholder Management

·      Commercial Negotiation and Collection Follow-up

·      Pipeline, Forecasting and Revenue Ownership

·      Problem Solving and Cross-functional Leadership

·      Strong communication, presentation and plant-level engagement skills

 Preferred Industry Exposure

Automotive & Auto Components • Steel & Metals • Cement • Power & Energy • Oil & Gas • Petrochemical • Chemicals • Pharmaceuticals • FMCG • Food Processing • Pulp & Paper • Mining • General Manufacturing • Process Industries • Industrial Automation / IIoT • Condition Monitoring / Predictive Maintenance

  Role Success Statement

* The core objective of the role is to grow strategic accounts by creating more value for customers. Success means deeper stakeholder relationships, more use cases, larger deployments, new plants and business units, stronger customer outcomes, healthy collections and sustainable year-on-year revenue growth.

title: Utilities Field Product Leader
description:
Founding Head — Utilities Field Product

**Build, roll out and grow OriginBluy's new field platform for gas utilities, from the first site to the next client.**

About OriginBluy

OriginBluy is building a new product: a field work platform that connects a city gas company's contractors, customer care and customers in one live job record. Contractors update each job on WhatsApp with photo proof. The status flows into the utility's SAP, and customers hear what is happening before they have to ask.

Our first deployment is a 90-day pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility that completes about 38,500 new connections a quarter. You will be the person who makes that pilot work on the ground, and the template for every city we expand to after it.

The role

You own the success of a new product, end to end. First, you make our pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility a clear success. Then you take that proof to other utilities and lead the sale. In the morning you may be on a site with a plumbing crew; in the afternoon, presenting results to an MD or pitching a new client.

This is a product-building role as much as an execution role. The platform is new, and contractors and their crews are the people who use it every day. You will help build it with them: what you observe and hear in the field decides what we build next.

You are the face of the product to contractors, to our first client's leadership and to every new utility we pursue. Contractors should trust you because you understand their work; senior leaders should trust you because you bring facts, not excuses. You report to the Founder and CEO and work as a partner in building the business.

**Title:**
 Founding Head – Utilities Field Product · 
**Type:**
 Contract to start then full time · 
**Base:**
 Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar

What you will do

**With contractors and crews**

* Onboard every contractor in the pilot area and get their crews updating jobs on WhatsApp with photo and GPS proof.
* Conduct field trainings for supervisors and plumbers, on site, in Gujarati or Hindi, and retrain crews where inspections fail.
* Demonstrate the product to contractors and their crews in 15 minutes, and get them using it the same day.
* Visit sites every week so contractors know the work is checked.
* Settle disputes between contractors, customers and the utility using the job evidence.
* Keep contractor capacity honest: jobs accepted only up to the number of certified crew available.

**With the utility's teams**

* Run a short daily review of the at-risk job list with the utility's area owner, and chase each delay until it is resolved.
* Work with care and service centre heads so their teams use the live job status in SAP.
* Present pilot progress to the MD and senior leadership: what moved, what is stuck, what you need from them.

**Building the product with OriginBluy**

* Shadow crews on real jobs and record structured observations: where time is lost, what confuses users, what workarounds they use.
* Turn those observations into clear product requirements with the product team.
* Test new features with contractors and crews before they are released, and bring back their feedback.
* Report what breaks in the field within days, with evidence.
* Track the pilot scorecard every week and own the numbers.
* Recruit and manage one or two field coordinators as the pilot scales.
* Document the playbook so the next city can be launched faster.

**Growing the business**

* Turn the pilot results into a clear, evidence-backed case for other gas utilities.
* Build a pipeline of target utilities, in Gujarat first and then other states.
* Run demos and discussions with MDs and heads of operations, projects and customer care.
* Shape proposals, pricing and pilot terms with the Founder.
* Lead new pilots and convert them into long-term contracts.
* Keep the first client a strong, willing reference.

Who you are

* **Mandatory: real, hands-on ground experience.**
   8–12 years doing field work yourself in city gas distribution, a utility, or an EPC or pipeline contractor, as a site engineer, site manager or operations manager. You have stood on sites, managed crews and contractors, and know how a PNG connection is built, from survey to gas-on. Desk-only or consulting backgrounds will not be considered.
* **Deep relationships across PSUs, government and utilities.**
   You have strong, active links with decision-makers in gas, power and other utility companies, PSUs and the government departments that oversee them, and you know how they evaluate, approve and buy.
* **Commercial instinct.**
   You have sold to, or won business from, utilities, PSUs or large industrial clients, or you are clearly ready to. You can open a door, run a meeting and follow through to a decision.
* **Equally at home on a site and in a boardroom.**
   You can win over a plumbing supervisor, and you can present calmly and crisply to an MD.
* **Fluent in Gujarati and Hindi,**
   with clear spoken and written English for leadership meetings and proposals.
* **A natural trainer and explainer.**
   You can take a non-technical crew through a new app and get them using it the same day.
* **A sharp observer.**
   You notice how work really gets done, and you can describe it clearly enough for a product team to act on.
* **Firm and fair with contractors.**
   You hold people to commitments without breaking the relationship.
* **Comfortable with data.**
   You live in dashboards and Excel, and you act on what the numbers show.
* **A builder.**
   You want to create something new, are comfortable with ambiguity, and own outcomes rather than tasks.
* **Graduate engineer**
   (mechanical, civil, chemical or petroleum preferred), or equivalent field experience.

Good to have

* Experience at a Gujarat city gas company, or with contractors who work for one.
* Experience with PSU and government procurement: tenders, empanelment and approval processes.
* Exposure to SAP in a utility (service orders, contractor billing or customer service).
* Experience rolling out a field app or digital process to a distributed, non-office workforce.
* Experience in a startup, or in a new-business role inside a larger company.
* A network of contractors, plumbers and site supervisors in Gujarat.

Location, pay and how to apply

* **Base:**
   Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar.
* **Travel:**
   frequent day trips to pilot sites and service centres in Gujarat (for example Surat and Bharuch), plus travel to other states for client meetings.
* **Ownership:**
   [ESOPs or equity, to be discussed].
* **Growth:**
   as the product scales, you build and lead the field and client team across utilities.

**To apply,**
 send your CV to Vivek.slaria@originbluy.com with a short note on one field rollout you led and one client you helped win: what was stuck, what you did, and what changed.

title: Manager - Student Recruitment & Outreach
description:
**Company Description**
ECA Global is a leading private higher education group founded in Australia, with multiple higher education brands across Sydney, Brisbane, Melbourne, Perth, and Parramatta. The group has expanded internationally with new campuses in the UK and operational hubs in Europe, China, the Philippines, Brazil, Nepal, and India. Each year, ECA Global welcomes around 15,000 students from diverse backgrounds into its global network of campuses. The organization focuses on delivering high-quality education, international pathways, and student-centric support services. ECA Global offers a multicultural work environment and opportunities to engage with learners and partners worldwide.

Position Summary: The Manager – Student Recruitment will lead and execute student recruitment strategies to achieve enrolment targets, expand market presence, strengthen institutional partnerships, and improve student conversion rates. The role is responsible for driving recruitment operations, developing effective outreach initiatives, managing recruitment channels, and building strong relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, and other institutional partners.

The successful candidate will combine strategic planning, commercial acumen, market intelligence, operational excellence, and people leadership to deliver sustainable student recruitment growth. The role will also work closely with academic teams, Admissions, Student Services, and other internal stakeholders to ensure a seamless prospective student journey from initial enquiry through enrolment and onboarding.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment Strategy, Market Development & Partnerships**

* Develop and implement comprehensive student recruitment strategies aligned with institutional enrolment targets and business growth objectives.
* Identify priority markets, student segments, recruitment channels, and opportunities for market expansion.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, academic institutions, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop articulation agreements, feeder relationships, and student progression pathways to strengthen recruitment pipelines and improve conversion.
* Collaborate with academic teams to align recruitment campaigns, messaging, and market positioning with programme offerings and institutional priorities.
* Lead relationship development and stakeholder engagement across key domestic and international markets.
* Leverage market research, CRM insights, competitor analysis, and enrolment trends to inform recruitment strategies and identify new growth opportunities.
* Represent the institution at recruitment fairs, school visits, industry events, partner meetings, presentations, and other outreach activities.
* Identify and develop innovative recruitment channels, partnership models, and market penetration initiatives.
* Monitor the effectiveness of recruitment partnerships and implement strategies to improve partner engagement and performance.

**2. Recruitment Operations, Student Conversion & Performance Management**

* Manage the end-to-end student recruitment pipeline, from enquiry generation and application follow-up through offer acceptance, enrolment, and onboarding.
* Drive timely, accurate, and high-quality communication with prospective students, applicants, and recruitment partners.
* Monitor recruitment funnel performance and implement initiatives to improve enquiry-to-application, application-to-offer, and offer-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Plan, coordinate, and oversee recruitment campaigns, marketing communications, outreach activities, open days, education fairs, and student engagement events.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), recruitment targets, pipeline metrics, and channel performance.
* Analyse recruitment data, identify conversion bottlenecks, and recommend corrective actions to improve enrolment outcomes.
* Prepare regular performance reports, market insights, pipeline updates, and strategic recommendations for senior management.
* Manage education agent performance, evaluate channel effectiveness, and implement appropriate performance improvement measures.
* Work closely with Admissions, Student Services, Marketing, and academic teams to ensure efficient application processing and a seamless student experience.

* Lead, motivate, and manage recruitment and outreach teams, where applicable, to achieve individual and collective performance targets.

* Promote data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and accountability for recruitment outcomes.

**4. Compliance, Governance & Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure recruitment practices comply with institutional policies, applicable regulatory requirements, and relevant quality assurance standards.

* Promote ethical recruitment practices, transparent communication, and a positive student experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Escalate recruitment risks, operational challenges, compliance concerns, and performance gaps in a timely manner.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be assessed against agreed institutional and departmental objectives, including:

* Achievement of student enrolment targets by programme, market, and recruitment channel.
* Improvement in enquiry-to-application and application-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Growth in qualified student enquiries and recruitment pipeline volume.
* Effectiveness and productivity of education agents and institutional partnerships.
* Delivery and performance of recruitment campaigns, outreach activities, and events.
* Timeliness and quality of applicant communication and follow-up.

* Proven experience managing recruitment pipelines, conversion processes, performance metrics, and stakeholder relationships.
* Experience developing and managing relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, or institutional partners.
* Previous experience leading or supervising teams, setting performance targets, and driving accountability will be highly desirable.
* Experience in higher education, international education, or a multi-campus education environment will be an advantage.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

title: Oracle Fusion Financial Consultant
description:
**About the Company**

Medovate Pvt Ltd is building a Technology and Operations Centre in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, to deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials services for a multi-entity international group operating across the United States, United Kingdom, Mexico, China, and India. The group runs Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP across multiple legal entities and ledgers, with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) connecting Fusion Financials to banking partners, intercompany systems, and external platforms.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an Oracle Fusion Finance Functional Consultant to strengthen the Finance practice at Medovate's Ahmedabad center. This is a hands-on functional delivery role. You will support the configuration and delivery of Oracle Fusion Financials across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets, working under the direction of the Finance Functional Lead and alongside senior consultants. You will contribute to design workshops, execute configuration, prepare functional documentation, and support testing across a multi-entity international environment. This is an opportunity to broaden your Oracle Fusion Financials experience across multiple modules and geographies while building depth in a specialist Finance capability.

**Responsibilities**

**Solution Design and Configuration**

* Participate in discovery workshops and requirements-gathering sessions with Finance business stakeholders across multiple legal entities and geographies.
* Contribute to the functional design of Oracle Fusion Financials, including Chart of Accounts structure, ledger setup, SLA accounting rules, tax determination, and period-close processes.
* Prepare functional specifications, configuration workbooks, and gap-fit analyses under the guidance of the Finance Functional Lead.
* Perform configuration across GL, AP, AR, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets in line with agreed design decisions and Oracle best-practice standards.
* Support the setup of intercompany accounting, netting arrangements, and consolidation hierarchies for a multi-entity international group structure.

**General Ledger (GL)**

* Support Chart of Accounts configuration across multiple legal entities covering US, UK, Mexico, China, and India reporting requirements.
* Configure ledgers, accounting calendars, currencies, and intercompany balancing rules under direction.
* Assist with configuration and validation of Subledger Accounting (SLA) rules to ensure accurate accounting distributions from subledgers into the GL.
* Support period-end close activities including subledger close, revaluation, translation, and intercompany elimination runs.

**Accounts Payable (AP)**

* Configure AP functionality covering invoice management, three-way PO matching, payment processing, supplier setup, and BPM approval workflows.
* Configure and test multi-country electronic payment formats (SEPA, BACS, SWIFT, ACH, NEFT/RTGS) and payment process profiles aligned to each entity's banking arrangements.
* Support AP-to-GL accounting configuration including liability accounts, prepayments, withholding tax, and intercompany payables.

**Accounts Receivable (AR)**

* Configure AR functionality covering customer billing, AutoInvoice rule setup, multi-currency receipts, lockbox processing, and deductions management.
* Support the configuration of receipt application rules, aging bucket setups, and bad debt provisioning.
* Support AR-to-GL accounting distributions including revenue recognition and intercompany receivables setups.

**Cash Management**

* Support bank account structure setup and bank statement reconciliation configuration across group entities and banking relationships.
* Configure automated reconciliation rules, tolerance thresholds, and exception handling for multi-currency bank statement matching.
* Support testing of OIC-delivered bank interface integrations, including statement import formats, reconciliation mapping, and error handling.

**Tax, Oracle Tax**

* Configure Oracle Fusion Tax across applicable regimes including GST (India), VAT (UK), IVA (Mexico), US Sales Tax, and China VAT/Fapiao, under the direction of the Finance Functional Lead.
* Support the setup of tax determination rules, tax condition sets, and tax registration configurations, including scenarios such as intercompany transactions, imports and exports, reverse charge, and withholding tax.
* Support indirect tax compliance activities and help ensure Oracle tax outputs meet local statutory reporting requirements.

**Fixed Assets (FA)**

* Configure Fixed Assets functionality including corporate and tax asset books, depreciation methods, prorate conventions, and mass addition rules.
* Support CIP-to-asset capitalization workflows, asset retirement processes, and revaluation setups across operating jurisdictions.
* Support FA period-end close activities including depreciation runs and FA-to-GL reconciliation.

**Delivery and Collaboration**

* Work with Finance business users to clarify requirements and resolve day-to-day functional queries.
* Contribute to the Finance workstream across project phases: Discover, Design, Build, Test, and Deploy, ensuring assigned deliverables are completed on time and to quality.
* Prepare test scripts, execute SIT and UAT cycles, and log and track defects to closure.
* Collaborate with Oracle Fusion technical teams on RICEW deliverables, providing functional input on Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, and Workflows.
* Support OIC integration testing connecting Oracle Fusion Financials to banking, intercompany, and external systems.
* Continuously build product knowledge across Oracle Fusion Financials modules and work towards relevant Oracle certifications.

**Qualifications and Skills**

***Required***

* 3 or more years of hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials functional experience, including at least one full-cycle implementation or a major rollout, upgrade, or support engagement.
* Practical configuration experience across at least three of the core modules: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets.
* Working knowledge of core Financials concepts including Chart of Accounts structures, ledger and accounting calendar setup, and Subledger Accounting (SLA).
* Experience preparing functional documentation such as configuration workbooks, functional specifications, and test scripts.
* Experience executing SIT and UAT cycles, logging defects, and tracking them to closure.
* Understanding of the period-end close process across subledgers and GL.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with Finance business users to clarify requirements.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.

***Preferred***

* Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials certification in one or more modules.
* Exposure to multi-entity, multi-currency, or multi-ledger environments.
* Experience with Oracle Tax configuration for one or more of GST (India), VAT (UK), IVA (Mexico), US Sales Tax, or China VAT.
* Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) delivered interfaces, particularly bank and intercompany integrations, from a functional testing perspective.
* Working knowledge of BPM approval workflow configuration.
* Exposure to RICEW deliverables and collaboration with technical teams.
* A professional accounting qualification (CA, CMA, ACCA, CPA, or part-qualified) is an advantage.

title: Strategic Initiatives Associate
description:
Strategic Initiatives Associate

SVECTOR | Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-site) | Full-time | Monday to Saturday

Experience: 0–4 years. Exceptional fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

Reports to: Founder-CEO

About SVECTOR

SVECTOR is a technology company building intelligence infrastructure for enterprises and institutions. We develop software systems that help organizations understand complex information, improve decision-making and execute critical business processes. Our initiatives span enterprise intelligence, talent and leadership decision systems, healthcare, industrial technology, financial intelligence and defensive intelligence.

We work on problems where technology must do more than generate information. It must help people understand what is happening, decide what to do and turn decisions into measurable outcomes.

About the Role

We are hiring a Strategic Initiatives Associate to work closely with company leadership on selected product, technology and business initiatives. This is an early-career role for someone curious, capable and dependable who wants to understand how a technology business runs while taking direct responsibility for meaningful work.

You will take assigned objectives, work out a practical approach, bring the right people together and carry the work through to a verified result. You will work across engineering, product and business teams on things like investigating a product issue, understanding a customer requirement, preparing a business analysis, coordinating a pilot or moving an initiative from planning into execution.

This is not a role defined by attending meetings, preparing presentations or passing instructions between departments. The goal is to contribute directly to work that produces results. Experience in an identical role is not required.

What You Will Do

Project execution

• Understand the objective, constraints and importance of each assigned initiative.

• Break objectives into activities, deliverables, owners and milestones.

• Coordinate with engineering, product and business stakeholders.

• Spot delays, dependencies and gaps early, and resolve blockers within your authority.

• Follow up on commitments and keep progress, pending actions and open issues visible.

• Check completed work against its original requirements.

• Prepare short progress summaries and flag decisions that need leadership attention.

You are expected to understand the work you coordinate. Collecting updates or maintaining a tracker without understanding the problem is not enough.

Product and technical-business work

• Use SVECTOR's software products to understand their real capabilities and limits.

• Understand customer workflows and the problems customers expect the product to solve.

• Investigate reported issues and tell defects apart from unclear requirements and new feature requests.

• Turn business and customer needs into clear problem statements, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Work with engineers to understand constraints, dependencies and possible approaches.

• Support demos, testing, customer pilots and implementation, and confirm delivered work meets the requirement.

You are not being hired as a full-time software developer, but strong technical literacy matters. You should be comfortable with concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations and data flows, and willing to learn what you do not yet know.

Research and analysis

• Research companies, industries, technologies and business opportunities.

• Compare competitors, products, technical approaches and tools.

• Study enterprise customers and the environments they operate in.

• Review reports, specifications and original source material.

• Prepare decision briefs and recommendations that state what is known, what the evidence is, what remains uncertain and what to do next.

We expect you to go beyond the first search result, verify important claims, check numbers and explain your reasoning. We value independent thinking over long documents full of generic observations.

Business and customer initiatives

• Research prospective customers and decision-makers, and prepare background for key discussions.

• Support demos, discovery calls and technical-business presentations.

• Turn customer feedback into specific product or business actions.

• Help with proposals and solution briefs, and coordinate pilot follow-ups.

• Join customer meetings and speak with external stakeholders when authorized.

There is no individual sales quota. Pricing, contracts and financial commitments stay subject to leadership approval.

Leadership support and AI tools

• Prepare briefing notes and short memos for important discussions.

• Record decisions, commitments and open questions, and keep actions tied to owners.

• Use AI tools and modern software for research, document analysis and repetitive workflows, and check their output against reliable sources.

Using AI does not remove your responsibility to understand your own work. An unverified AI-generated document that you cannot explain is not an acceptable deliverable. You will also follow company rules on confidential information and data handling.

Who You Are

• Curious: you want to understand a hard problem, not avoid it.

• Accountable: a task is done when there is an outcome, not when you have sent a message. You are honest about obstacles and mistakes.

• Structured: you break problems down, test assumptions and reach reasoned conclusions, even under uncertainty.

• Clear communicator: excellent written and spoken English, with precise emails, briefs and summaries.

• Technically curious: you enjoy learning how software is built and used. Coding experience helps but is not required.

• Reliable: you respect deadlines and confidentiality, know when you need approval, and accept feedback well.

Qualifications

• 0–4 years of relevant experience. Internships, independent projects, research, entrepreneurship or full-time work all count.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, AI, Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Management or a related field is preferred. Other backgrounds are considered where projects show the capability. No MBA required.

• Experience in product operations, business analysis, technical consulting, software development, strategic research or project execution is relevant.

We care about work you have actually completed: a product or technical project, an internship where you solved a real problem, a research assignment with a defensible conclusion, or an initiative where you took responsibility beyond your assigned work. Tell us your own contribution, the decisions you made and the results.

This role is not an administrative or personal-assistant job, a software engineering job focused on production code, a pure consulting role or a senior management position. It is an execution-oriented role centered on product understanding, research, problem-solving and completing assigned initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

• First 30 days: learn the products, workflows and priorities, and complete initial research and product assignments accurately.

• Days 31–60: own a defined initiative, prepare an execution approach and keep progress visible.

• Days 61–90: carry an initiative to an agreed result or a documented handover.

Hiring Process

1. Application review

2. Initial discussion

3. Practical assessment: a realistic research, product or business task. AI tools may be used where permitted, but you must be able to explain and verify your work.

4. Leadership interview

5. Offer discussion: responsibilities, compensation, schedule and joining date are confirmed before a written offer.

Working Arrangements

Full-time, on-site in Ahmedabad, Monday to Saturday. Schedule, compensation and joining terms are confirmed before a formal offer. If anything about the role or location does not match your expectations, please raise it in the first discussion.

How to Apply

Send your resume with a short note covering:

1. Your strongest example of ownership: what you did, which decisions you made and what happened.

2. Why you are interested in technology, research, product understanding and business execution.

3. Your current location, availability to work full-time on-site in Ahmedabad and earliest joining date.

Links to projects, GitHub, portfolios or research are welcome. Please skip the generic statements.

title: Senior Application Associate, Financial Modeling
description:

**Grade Level (for internal use):**
08
  
  
**The Team**
The Financial Modeling Group provides expert services for our most sophisticated analytical tools so that we can provide clients with a tailored experience when using our products. This global, seasoned team specializes in onboarding and client adoption for our Excel add-ins, Office Tools products, Screening and Platform customization, and Proprietary Data capabilities. title: Senior Implementation Consultant – EHR / EMR / HIS
description:
📍 India | UK business hours

🧠 Typically 3–8 years’ relevant experience

📅 Notice periods up to 45 days welcome

🚀 Bring your EHR expertise to the next generation of private healthcare

You know how healthcare software works. You can understand a customer’s workflows, design the right configuration, explain the product confidently and take an implementation through to go-live.

Now imagine owning that entire journey—and remaining the person the customer trusts as their business grows.

Script Assist is hiring a
**Senior Implementation Consultant**
with experience implementing, configuring and optimising Electronic Health Record (EHR), Electronic Medical Record (EMR), Electronic Patient Record (EPR) or Hospital Information System (HIS / HMIS) platforms.

We are particularly interested in professionals with experience across Oracle Health / Cerner, eClinicalWorks, Altera / Allscripts, Epic, NextGen Healthcare, InterSystems TrakCare, MEDITECH, athenahealth, Dedalus or comparable healthcare software.

You may currently work at an EHR vendor, a healthcare technology company, or within the healthcare technology consulting teams of PwC, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, Accenture, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, HCLTech or CitiusTech.

If you built your product expertise at an EHR vendor and subsequently moved into healthcare technology consulting, we would particularly like to hear from you.

**🏥 About Script Assist**

Script Assist is building the technology and operating infrastructure behind next-generation private healthcare in the UK.

Our platform already supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month, with established scale in medical cannabis and expansion into ADHD, weight management, longevity and specialist private medicine.

We bring together the workflows that clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators need to run their services:

• Patient onboarding and patient portals

• Clinical consultations and scheduling

• Prescribing and repeat prescriptions

• Pharmacy, dispensing and inventory

• Payments and operational workflows

• Patient communications, reporting and integrations

Every customer operates differently. Your role is to understand those differences, design the right solution and help each customer get the best from Script Assist.

You will work directly with UK healthcare customers and closely with our leadership, Product and Engineering teams—with real influence over customer delivery and product development.

**🎯 The opportunity**

You will become a product expert and trusted client lead for UK clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators.

You will understand their operations, design their workflows, configure their solution, demonstrate the product, train their teams and guide them through implementation.

After go-live, you will retain ownership of the relationship, helping customers resolve problems, improve adoption and develop how they use the platform.

The role brings together:

• EHR implementation and functional consulting

• Clinical and operational workflow design

• Application configuration and solution design

• Client workshops, product demonstrations and training

• UAT, go-live and post-implementation optimisation

• Ongoing client ownership and stakeholder management

**⚙️ What you will own**

Workflow discovery and functional solution design

• Lead client discovery sessions and requirements workshops.

• Map clinical and operational processes into clear system workflows.

• Translate requirements into configuration decisions, functional specifications and acceptance criteria.

• Advise customers on how to use the product effectively.

• Identify dependencies, explain trade-offs and challenge requirements constructively.

EHR application configuration

• Configure or lead the configuration of modules, forms, clinical templates, user roles, permissions, rules and system settings.

• Understand how configuration decisions affect the wider patient, clinician and pharmacy journey.

• Work across registration, appointments, clinical documentation, prescribing, medication management, work queues, patient portals and payments.

• Identify which requirements can be met through configuration and which need integration or product development.

Implementation and go-live

• Own customer delivery from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, training and go-live.

• Coordinate data migration, integrations and customer dependencies with specialist teams.

• Lead UAT preparation, issue resolution and go-live readiness.

• Deliver product demonstrations, workflow walkthroughs and user training.

• Manage hypercare and the transition into ongoing platform use.

Client consulting and relationship ownership

• Lead meetings with clinicians, operational managers and senior healthcare stakeholders.

• Explain system behaviour and recommendations clearly and confidently.

• Manage expectations, priorities, actions and escalations.

• Maintain a detailed understanding of each customer’s workflows, configuration and objectives.

• Build lasting relationships through product knowledge, sound judgement and reliable follow-through.

Post-implementation optimisation

• Remain directly involved after go-live.

• Improve adoption, workflows, configuration and user confidence.

• Diagnose issues involving permissions, data, configuration, training, integrations or software behaviour.

• Translate product gaps into clear requirements for Product and Engineering.

• Validate fixes and follow issues through to resolution.

**✅ The experience we are looking for**

• Typically 3–8 years of relevant EHR, EMR, EPR, HIS or clinical information systems experience. Strong candidates outside this range are welcome.

• Deep functional knowledge of at least one substantial healthcare software platform.

• Personal involvement in system configuration or detailed configuration design.

• Experience delivering implementations or substantial optimisation projects for external healthcare customers.

• Direct responsibility for client workshops, requirements discussions, training or implementation decisions.

• Confidence investigating application and workflow problems.

• Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, QA and Support.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to independently lead senior UK client conversations.

• A hands-on approach and enthusiasm for learning a complex healthcare product.

**🔎 Relevant platforms and backgrounds**

We welcome experience with:

• Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium

• eClinicalWorks / eCW

• Altera Digital Health / Allscripts, including Sunrise and TouchWorks

• Veradigm

• Epic

• NextGen Healthcare / NextGen Enterprise

• InterSystems TrakCare

• MEDITECH / Expanse

• athenahealth / athenaOne

• Dedalus

• PracticeSuite, MicroMD, Napier, Ohum and other substantial EHR / EMR / HIS platforms

Relevant functional experience may include ambulatory care, outpatient workflows, patient administration, scheduling, clinical documentation, electronic prescribing, medication management, pharmacy, patient engagement and practice management.

Experience working with US, UK or other international healthcare customers is particularly valuable.

Relevant current or previous roles

Your title may be:

• Implementation Consultant / Senior Implementation Consultant

• Functional Consultant / Senior Functional Consultant

• Clinical Consultant / Clinical Applications Consultant

• Application Consultant / Application Specialist

• Delivery Consultant / Senior Associate Delivery Consultant

• EMR Consultant / EHR Consultant

• Clinical Information System Consultant

• Implementation Project Manager / EMR Project Manager

• Post Implementation Project Manager

• Implementation Manager / Client Onboarding Manager

• Product Specialist / Solution Consultant

• Healthcare Technology Consultant / Senior Associate

Candidates in EHR product ownership, business analysis or strategic client delivery are also welcome where their experience includes substantial configuration knowledge and personal implementation responsibility.

**🌟 Why join Script Assist?**

• Work directly with UK healthcare customers and senior decision-makers.

Prepare change ordersoramendments in orders and facilitate contract closures.
  
  
Manage inbound logistics services and execute contingency plans as needed.

Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and value through data analysis.
  
  
Contribute to action planning and implementation based on data analytics.

Identify procurement risks using master lists, supply market analysis, and risk registers.
  
  
Evaluate and prioritize risks based on likelihood, impact, and controllability.
  
  
Contribute to the preparation of risk mitigation plans and update category risk registers.

Integrate digital solutions for efficient inventory management, ensuring optimal stock levels and reducing procurement-related delays.

Projects team
  
  
Marketing department

title: Customer Relationship Management Consultant
description:
Customer Care Transformation Consultant

**Engagement:**
 Monthly contract. Full-time on the client through diagnostics, then a delivery role as the program moves into training and monitoring.

About the role
  

OriginBluy is running a Customer Care Gold Standard program for a large utility that serves more than 23 lakh households through 60+ walk-in service centres and an inbound call centre.

The consultant is our person on the ground: they diagnose how service works today, help define the Gold Standard, and stay through training and monitoring until the client’s own managers can hold the standard.

They report to the Principal Coach and work directly with the client’s customer care leadership, centre managers and call centre teams.

What you’ll do

**Diagnose**

* Run mystery shopping at walk-in centres: brief and calibrate the shoppers, score visits and consolidate the findings
* Select and listen to recorded calls with a focus on outliers (best, worst, repeat and escalated calls) and find the root cause of each: behaviour, process, system or policy
* Interview centre managers, call centre team leads and functional heads
* Pull together existing SOPs, scripts, QA formats and MIS into one baseline

**Define**

* Map the end-to-end customer journey for the top contact reasons, both walk-in and call
* Draft the Gold Standard: interaction standards, scripts, SOPs, escalation paths and the scorecard
* Build the cost-benefit case with client Finance: contact volumes, repeat rates, cost per contact
* Run dry runs of the new standard with a pilot group and refine it

**Deliver and sustain**

* Co-deliver CSE and manager workshops with the trainer
* Administer the Ready-for-floor certification test
* Run post-training mystery shopping and call audits, produce centre-wise scores and prepare packs for leadership reviews
* Coach centre managers and TLs to observe, score and coach against the standard

What you bring

**Must have**

* **10–15 years in customer service operations**
  , including all three of the following:
* **Inbound call centre:**
   managed or ran operations or quality for an inbound voice operation, ideally 50+ seats. Hands-on with call quality monitoring, AHT, first-contact resolution, CSAT and repeat-call analysis.
* **Walk-in service centres:**
   managed a network of customer service centres or branches. Knows queue and token management, counter processes, document-heavy service requests and how to manage a multi-location network.
* **Transformation projects:**
   led at least two service transformation or process improvement projects end to end. This could be SOP standardisation, a service redesign, a contact-centre turnaround, or harmonising processes after a merger, with results you can show.
* Comfortable with data: builds analyses in Excel, works with call logs and MIS, and can turn numbers into a business case
* Can run a good interview and a good workshop. Credible with a functional head and comfortable with a frontline executive.
* **Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English**
   (spoken; written Gujarati preferred)
* Willing to travel extensively within Gujarat

**Good to have**

* Experience in utilities, city gas distribution, power distribution, telecom, banking or insurance, meaning large regulated consumer bases with high volumes of service requests
* Familiarity with regulator-defined service standards and complaint timelines (e.g., PNGRB, state electricity regulatory commission norms)
* Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt or above) or COPC exposure
* Experience with outsourced or agency staffing models in contact centres
* Training delivery or facilitation experience

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* A credible baseline from mystery shopping and call audits that the client’s leadership accepts
* A Gold Standard draft built from the client’s own best interactions, signed off by the client owner
* A cost-benefit case that the client’s Finance team has validated
* Strong working relationships with centre managers and call centre TLs, so that they see the program as support rather than an audit

Personal attributes

* Good at reading and getting on with people on the shop floor; earns trust quickly with frontline teams
* Rigorous with evidence: separates what they saw from what they were told
* Discreet with client data and with individual performance information
* Self-directed and able to run the program on the ground without close supervision

Our solutions span predictive maintenance, energy analytics, digital twins and video analytics, deployed across Cement, Automotive, Chemical, FMCG, Steel, Metals and Pharma.

Today, MachineAstro is trusted by 120+ manufacturing plants across the globe. We have installed 20,000+ IoT devices on 8,000+ assets and helped our customers avoid 6,000+ hours of unplanned downtime. Those are not pilot numbers. They are production numbers, earned one plant at a time.

 Why join MachineAstro

1. **Opportunity to scale a proven business:**
   our solution already runs across 120+ plants and 8,000+ monitored assets, so your work drives growth, not pilots.
2. **Work where AI meets the plant floor:**
   real sensor data, real failure modes, real industrial problems.
3. **Earn what you deliver:**
   quarterly variable pay tied directly to KPI achievement.

 Who we are looking for

We are entering our next phase of growth and need enterprising, self-motivated people who want to own outcomes. People who are comfortable walking into a steel plant or a pharma line, understanding what keeps the plant head awake at night, and translating that into a solution the customer will pay for and keep. People who treat a customer's downtime as their own problem.

 What you will do

* **Recruit partners:**
  identify, qualify and sign system integrators, distributors and value-added resellers across Middle East and Southeast Asia markets.
* **Enable partners:**
  train partners on condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, Industrial IoT and edge computing use cases so they can position and demonstrate MachineAstro solutions on their own.
* **Demonstrate the platform:**
  run online and offline software demonstrations for partners and their end customers.
* **Deliver channel revenue:**
  own sales targets through indirect channels, and build joint account plans and pipeline with each partner.
* **Generate demand:**
  design and run regional and partner campaigns and emailers for lead generation.
* **Negotiate and manage:**
  negotiate partner terms and manage multiple partners and countries in parallel, with pipeline and activity tracked in HubSpot.

 Qualifications

* BE in Instrumentation & Control or Electronics & Communication preferred.
* MBA in Business Administration, Marketing or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 8–10 years of experience selling industrial software, Industrial IoT or industrial automation solutions to manufacturing or process industries.
* Proven experience in channel or partner development, including recruiting and growing system integrators, distributors or value-added resellers.

title: Procurement Manager
description:
**About the Role:**

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Procurement Manager to build and manage a scalable procurement portfolio that supports the company's growth, cost optimisation, technology deployments and sustainability objectives. The role will lead strategic sourcing, supplier selection, vendor relationship, inventory management, commercial negotiations and procurement governance across technology, SaaS, IoT, hardware, engineering, professional services and project-related requirements.

The Procurement Manager will work closely with Finance, Engineering, Product, Sales, Project Delivery, Operations and other stakeholders to translate business and customer requirements into cost-effective, resilient and sustainable procurement solutions. The role will combine hands-on execution with strategic supplier and category management, ensuring the right quality, value, service and delivery at the right total cost.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute procurement strategies aligned with Ecolibrium's business plans, technology roadmap, customer deployments and operational requirements.
* Lead strategic sourcing activities, including supplier identification, qualification, RFIs/RFQs/RFPs, competitive evaluation, negotiations and contract award.
* Manage procurement across technology and SaaS categories, including software licences, cloud and data services, IoT devices, sensors, gateways, networking equipment, hardware and related services.
* Support project procurement for customer deployments by translating project requirements into procurement plans, budgets, sourcing activities and delivery schedules.
* Build and manage a preferred supplier ecosystem, including supplier onboarding, due diligence, performance management, reviews and continuous improvement.
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, payment terms, service levels, warranties, lead times and other contractual requirements to achieve best total cost of ownership.
* Work with Finance and business stakeholders on budgets, forecasts, spend analysis, savings, cost avoidance and procurement reporting.
* Establish and monitor supplier KPIs covering cost, quality, service, delivery, responsiveness and contractual performance.
* Identify and mitigate supplier, supply-chain and business-continuity risks, including critical supplier dependencies and alternative sourcing options.
* Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, delegated authorities, approval processes and relevant legal and regulatory requirements.
* Drive procurement process improvements, standardisation, transparency and appropriate use of procurement/ERP tools and data analytics.
* Resolve supplier issues and commercial disputes promptly, escalating material risks appropriately and maintaining constructive long-term supplier relationships.
* Develop procurement dashboards and management information to provide visibility of spend, savings, supplier performance, contract status and key procurement risks.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Finance or a related field discipline.
* Proven procurement, strategic sourcing or supplier-management experience, preferably within a technology, SaaS, IoT, telecom, data-centre, engineering or other asset-intensive environment.
* Demonstrated experience in supplier sourcing, commercial negotiations, contract management, infrastructure deployment and vendor performance management.
* Strong commercial and analytical capability, with the ability to assess pricing, total cost of ownership, value and supplier performance.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and translating technical or business requirements into effective procurement solutions.
* Strong understanding of procurement processes, supply-chain principles, controls and governance.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and familiarity with ERP, procurement or supplier-management systems.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Certification in Procurement or supply chain management qualification.
