title: Specialist Bridges
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
We are seeking an accomplished
**Specialist Bridges**
to drive the domestic delivery and support strategic growth within our Transport Structures team. This senior role is central to strengthening our position in India’s bridge market—especially in complex projects, major infrastructure bids, and capture management for priority pursuits.
  
  
You will play a key role in steering high‑quality technical outputs, leading teams on complex structures, and shaping winning strategies for major tenders. With deep structural background and proven leadership across design and bidding cycles, you will help elevate our technical excellence, expand client relationships, and support the successful delivery of iconic design and build bridge projects across India and overseas. In this role you will provide
  
  
**Technical Leadership**

* Direct and manage design for long‑span bridges, complex structures, and other transportation structures in multi-disciplinary infrastructure projects
* Provide technical direction, guidance, and mentorship to junior engineers and cross-functional project teams.
* Responsible for managing quality assurance in project delivery, complying to Jacobs Quality Management systems.
* Support clients in technical decision-making, providing opening and middle game support in strategic pursuits, providing robust engineering solutions.

**Project Delivery**

* Oversee design schedule, resources, budget, and deliverables to ensure timely and high‑quality outcomes, keeping our clients delighted.
* Coordinate effectively with clients, contractors, consultants, internal teams and all other relevant stakeholders throughout all design stages.

**Bidding & Capture Management**

* Drive the preparation of technical proposals, scope of Works, resource plans, and financial estimates for domestic infrastructure bids, benchmarking with the market standards and requirements.
* Partner closely with business development teams to shape winning strategies for major pursuits
* Lead capture planning efforts for long‑span bridges/major crossings, and transport structure opportunities

**Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to organizational quality standards, industry regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Conduct technical reviews, risk assessments, and ensure appropriate mitigation strategies are implemented.

**Client & Market Engagement**

* Build and nurture relationships with key clients, government agencies, and major industry partners.
* Stay connected to the domestic infrastructure market to identify early opportunities and support pursuit strategies.
* Represent the organization at technical forums, client meetings, and industry events.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering (Structures specialization preferred).
* Minimum of 15 years of experience in bridge design and projecy delivery.
* Extensive background in domestic infrastructure projects, including highways, railways, and urban development. Having exposure to international clients will be preferred.
* Proven experience preparing proposals and bids for government and private sector clients in domestic market.
* Proficiency in structural analysis and design software such as STAAD Pro, MIDAS, etc.
* Comprehensive knowledge of IRC, IRS, IS codes, and MoRTH specifications. Exposure to international standards like AASHTO and Eurocodes will be preferred.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills.
* Ability to work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Integration Analyst
description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.
  
  
Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.
  
  
Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**
As an Integration Analyst, you own, lead and deliver EDI and 3PL integrations between Cin7 customers and external trading partners. You provide technical support to the Cin7 client base, resolving technical issues and determining the client’s service and support needs.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Ownership & Time Management**
Accelerates connection lifecycles toward successful completion through expert troubleshooting and debugging. Proactively manages dependencies for all assigned tasks while participating in requirement analysis and necessary exploratory research. Demonstrates the capability to isolate technical discrepancies to identify fundamental root causes.
  
  
Assumes full accountability for delivering small to medium-complexity projects, adapting functional strategies independently or within a team to secure optimal results.
  
  
**Technical & Product knowledge**
Possesses a comprehensive understanding of EDI architecture and proficiency in the requisite tooling for connection development. Skilled in executing testing protocols to diagnose reproducible defects and propose technical resolutions. Confidently manages compliance validation across diverse retail and trading partner landscapes. Enhances collective team expertise through domain knowledge sharing, supported by a firm grasp of EDI, 3PL, and API integration workflows and bug remediation.
  
  
**Customer Engagement & Escalations**
Maintains proactive, solution-oriented dialogue with clients, ensuring expectations are managed with transparency. Coordinates with leadership to influence outcomes when necessary and provides clear communication regarding functional limitations and feasible paths for issue resolution.
  
  
**Drives Results**
Reliably achieves established monthly and quarterly performance metrics, pursuing ambitious stretch targets to consistently surpass client expectations.
  
  
**Team Work**
Operates with high autonomy, selecting workstreams that align with organizational objectives. Actively participates in collaborative forums to exchange ideas and contributes to the maintenance of critical team documentation.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement**
Evaluates the broader implications of design choices and proposes enhanced alternatives. Cultivates a growth mindset while playing a central role in refining team methodologies and operational practices to increase scalability and efficiency.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Tertiary education with a relevant degree
* 3+ years in a client-facing role, strong understanding of relevant technologies and platforms (supply chain, inventory management, EDI/3PL) and sufficient technical knowledge in SQL, HTML, CSS, and web-based applications.
* Strong technical problem solving skills and complex understanding of customer pain points
* Deep domain knowledge
* Excellent customer service skills with consistent follow-up and the ability to handle customer requests and issues independently. Seeks feedback to improve service delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple connections or projects simultaneously, especially for medium- to large-sized customers.
* Proven track record of delivering exceptional customer service with strong feedback and reviews.
* Change Management skills and the ability to identify and implement process improvements to enhance the efficiency and scalability of EDI/3PL connections.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and conflict resolution skills, with the ability to manage and realign escalated connections.
* Demonstrated ownership skills

**Why work for us?**

* We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.
* You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
* Hybrid work environment
* Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
* Recruitment referral bonus
* Work for a Great Place to Work®

₹12,00,000 - ₹14,00,000 a year
  
  
**Why CIN7?**
CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
  
  
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.
  
  
***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***

title: Franchise Development Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 The Concrete Shop® is a curated platform that showcases design\-led concrete products and architectural elements for architects, designers, and creators. The company unites premium concrete products and specialized brands, enabling users to explore concrete’s full potential as an architectural material. Its work is driven by advanced precast technologies such as FRC, GRC, SFRC, PFRC, UHPC, and decorative and pigmented concrete, allowing for strong, precise, and flexible design outcomes. With a portfolio of more than 2,500 products spanning furniture, planters, lighting, landscape elements, and architectural components, The Concrete Shop® is built on continuous experimentation with material, form, and engineering. The team views concrete as a medium for purposeful design that shapes environments, objects, and everyday experiences.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Franchise Development Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role involves identifying and qualifying prospective franchise partners, managing lead generation activities, and guiding candidates through the franchise evaluation and onboarding process. The Franchise Development Manager will develop and present franchise business plans, collaborate on territory and expansion strategies, and maintain relationships with existing franchisees to support their growth and performance. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting discovery meetings, preparing franchise proposals, coordinating training for new franchise partners, and working closely with internal teams to ensure brand and operational standards are consistently met. The role also includes tracking sales metrics, reporting on pipeline status, and contributing insights to refine the overall franchise strategy.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Franchise development skills, including Franchise Sales and Franchising expertise, with experience managing end\-to\-end franchise lifecycle.
* Business\-focused capabilities such as Business Planning and strategic analysis to evaluate franchise models, territories, and financial viability.
* Lead Generation and pipeline management skills to source, qualify, and nurture prospective franchise partners through structured sales processes.
* Training and onboarding skills to design and deliver effective training programs for new and existing franchisees.
* Strong communication and negotiation abilities, with the capacity to present complex concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* Proven experience in franchise development, business development, or related sales roles; experience in design, construction, or building materials is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work on\-site in Ahmedabad, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and use CRM and productivity tools effectively.

title: Territory Business Associate
description:
**About Aipri Lifesciences LLP** 




 Established in 2025 and headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, Aipri Lifesciences is an emerging, fast\-growing medical device company dedicated to delivering high\-quality surgical solutions. Founded and led by a medical doctor with extensive cross\-functional experience in clinical research and pharma medical affairs, Aipri bridges the gap between clinical necessity and technical excellence.
 



  





**What We Do** 




 We specialize in the technical design, material specification, and commercialization of premium surgical consumables, including advanced braided sutures (like Aicryl Polyglactin 910\) and surgical skin glue. Driven by a commitment to superior patient outcomes, we are aggressively expanding our product portfolio into a wider array of advanced medical instruments and devices.
 



  





**Our Vision \& Culture** 




 Our vision is to build Aipri into a highly respected, successful brand with a global reach. We are grounded in the core values of honesty, humility, intelligence, and kindness. At Aipri, we maintain a positive, realistic, and dependable work environment that respects the balance between ambitious business growth and personal peace of mind.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 Working at Aipri means joining a forward\-thinking, doctor\-led enterprise where your contributions directly impact the healthcare ecosystem. We offer structured compensation models, a clear strategic roadmap, and a collaborative environment where disciplined, dependable, and intellectually driven professionals can thrive and build a meaningful career.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Operation Theater (OT) Engagement:** 
 Spend active time in hospital OT environments, supporting surgeons and OT teams during product evaluation to build clinical confidence in Aipri’s suture portfolio.



  




* **Surgeon \& Specialty Coverage:** 
 Build and maintain direct relationships with key surgeons across multiple specialties (General Surgery, OB\-GYN, Orthopedics).



  




* **Territory \& Account Management:** 
 Map private hospitals, nursing homes, and day\-care surgical centers in assigned Ahmedabad clusters; identify new accounts and drive repeat orders.



  




* **Institutional \& Purchase Coordination:** 
 Engage Hospital Purchase Managers, Procurement Teams, and OT Sisters\-in\-Charge to facilitate product code listings, vendor registration, and seamless ordering.



  




* **Supply \& Delivery Support:** 
 Coordinate with the internal operations team to ensure direct, next\-day product delivery to hospital clients and manage local inventory needs.



  




* **Market \& Competitor Intelligence:** 
 Track local surgeon preference shifts, competitor activity, and hospital procurement dynamics, reporting field insights directly to leadership.



  





**Candidate Profile \& Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy (B.Pharm / M.Pharm), Biotechnology, or related fields.
* 1 to 3 years in Surgical Devices, Medical Consumables, OT Products, or Clinical Hospital Sales in Ahmedabad.
* Fully comfortable working within the Operation Theater (OT) environment and interacting directly with surgical teams.
* Existing contacts with surgeons, OT staff, and hospital purchase departments across key Ahmedabad surgical clusters.
* Strong scientific learning aptitude, relationship\-building skills, commercial negotiation ability, and high integrity.
* Must own a two\-wheeler with a valid driving license for daily local territory coverage.



  





**Field Working Structure \& Culture** 



* Working Days: Monday to Saturday.
* Field Timings: Aligned with surgeon availability and OT schedules (starts at 9:30 AM; flexible field wrap\-up based on daily doctor appointments and hospital rounds).
* Compensation: Competitive fixed salary (commensurate with experience) \+ Daily Local Conveyance Allowance (TA/DA) \+ Incentives.

title: Specification Manager - Luxury Interiors & Projects
description:
**JSB is looking for someone who sells a premium material to architects, designers, developers and discerning homeowners — and wants a better one to sell them.** 




  





**About** 




  





 Founded in Kishangarh in 1993, JSB is one of India's largest importers and processors of natural marble. We buy blocks directly at the quarry across more than 40 countries, process them at our own facility, and hold over 400 colours in live inventory — Statuario, Calacatta, Brazilian quartzite, onyx, travertine and exotic stones.
 



  





 Architects, designers, developers and homeowners travel from across India to our Kishangarh Experience Centre to select their slabs personally.
 



  





 We deal in imported marble only. No Indian marble. No granite.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 We are opening Ahmedabad, and we are looking for the person who will own Gujarat.
 



  





 This is specification work. There is no dealer network to appoint and no monthly order book to service. Your job is to make JSB the material that gets specified — the name reached for when a project calls for something extraordinary underfoot.
 



  





 Your clientele is the full top end of the market:
 



  





 • Architects and design studios
 



 • Interior designers and turnkey interior firms
 



 • Luxury residential and hospitality developers
 



 • Project management consultants on premium projects
 



 • HNI homeowners building or renovating privately
 



  





 You will get JSB specified at design stage, hold the relationship through material selection, and bring your client to Kishangarh to choose their stone with their own eyes.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  





 • Build a specification map of Gujarat's top end — studio by studio, developer by developer, principal by principal — starting in Ahmedabad and extending through Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Surat and Rajkot
 



 • Get JSB specified at design stage on luxury residences, villas and farmhouses, high\-end apartment projects, hospitality, premium retail and flagship corporate interiors
 



 • Work both sides of a project: the design studio that specifies the material, and the developer, PMC or homeowner who signs for it
 



 • Run material presentations, place samples, and establish JSB inside design studio material libraries
 



 • Bring clients to Kishangarh. Marble is chosen with the eye. Your project becomes real when your client is standing in our slab yard, looking at the block.
 



 • Guide clients through selection: colour, veining, book\-matching, finish, and how a slab will read in the space it is going into
 



 • Own the project from selection through to delivery coordination with HQ
 



 • Maintain a disciplined pipeline: project, area in sq ft, stage, decision maker
 



  





**Who we are looking for** 




  





 You are most likely doing something close to this today at a luxury interiors or premium surfaces brand — Kohler, TOTO, Duravit, Grohe, Hansgrohe, Roca, Villeroy \& Boch, Artize, Cosentino, Caesarstone, Laminam, Häfele, Hettich, Asian Paints Beautiful Homes, Saint\-Gobain, Greenlam, or a premium lighting or decorative finishes brand.
 



  





 What matters more than the logo on your card:
 



  





 • 6 to 12 years selling a premium or luxury interior product into design studios and high\-end projects, with Ahmedabad and Gujarat as your working territory
 



 • A live relationship map you personally own — architects, interior designers, luxury developers, PMCs and HNI clients
 



 • You have sold a premium material against a cheaper alternative and won on design and value, not on discount
 



 • You can hold your own in a design conversation. You understand that when an architect chooses a material, they are choosing how a room will feel — and you can talk about it that way.
 



 • You can also hold your own in a commercial conversation with a developer or PMC on rate, quantity and delivery
 



 • You are comfortable in premium rooms: design studios, owner\-side site meetings, HNI drawing rooms
 



 • Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English
 



 • Graduate. A B.Arch or interior design background is a genuine advantage. MBA optional.
 



  





**Straight talk before you apply** 




  





 We would rather lose you at the advert than at month three.
 



  





 • There is no regional office or showroom in Ahmedabad. You work from the field, out of design studios and client sites. Telecalling, back office, inventory and processing all sit at Kishangarh HQ.
 



 • There is no dedicated company vehicle. Travel is reimbursed against actuals.
 



 • Clients buy by seeing the slab. A meaningful part of your performance is how many qualified clients you bring to Kishangarh.
 



 • The first 90 days are field\-first. Personal meetings, personally done.
 



 • Compensation is part fixed and part performance. The variable is uncapped and tiered by project value band, so specifying higher\-value stone pays you materially more.
 



  





 If you want a showroom to sit in and a dealer network to service, this is not your role. If you want to build a territory in your own name, for a house that buys its own blocks at the quarry and processes them itself, it is.
 



  





**What we offer** 




  





 • Fixed salary of 5\-6 LPA, based on experience and the strength of your existing network
 



 • Uncapped tiered incentive on project value, paid above threshold
 



 • Travel reimbursed at actuals, plus mobile allowance
 



 • A material with genuine range. Over 400 colours in live inventory, so you are rarely the one saying no.
 



 • Direct access to principal\-level decision making. We own the buying, the inventory and the processing, so you are never waiting on a third party to quote.
 



  





**To apply** 




  





 Email keshav.bangur@jsbstonex.com with the subject line: Specification Manager – Ahmedabad – \[Your Name]
 



  





 Answer these three questions in your email. Applications that do not answer them are not reviewed.
 



  





 1\. Name three architecture, design or developer clients in Ahmedabad you have personally worked with, and the person you deal with at each.
 



 2\. What is the largest single project you have personally specified? Project type and approximate area or value.
 



 3\. Your current fixed CTC and notice period.
 



  





 Applications are reviewed personally. If you are shortlisted, you will hear from us within five working days.

title: Director - Aftermarket
description:
**Director\-Aftermarke** 
 t is the end\-to\-end P\&L owner for Milacron India's aftermarket business, spanning spares revenue, service delivery, customer success, and channel economics.
   

  

 This role is intended to create a single accountability center for aftermarket growth and is expected to unlock Whitespace revenue across the installed base by establishing structured coverage, pricing discipline, and cross\-functional execution rigor.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
**P\&L Ownership \& Revenue Growth**
* Own the complete national aftermarket P\&L – spares revenue, M\-Powered, retrofits, service billings and new AM product lines
* Set and deliver annual revenue targets in partnership with Head of Sales \& Marketing and Regional leadership
* Protect margin guardrails across pricing, channel economics and service billing models
* Lead monthly AM reviews with Regional Aftermarket Heads; drive corrective action on revenue and coverage gaps


**Strategy \& Growth Roadmap**
* Own the AM growth roadmap, including identified growth initiatives, installed\-base monetization, M\-Powered conversion, retrofit pipeline
* Identify and quantify whitespaces across the installed base and drive focused coverage through the KAM structure
* Define channel strategy – dealer network expansion, stocking norms, pricing discipline and genuine\-parts compliance
* Build the customer value proposition for premium AM offerings; differentiate Milacron service from third\-party competition


**Organizational Leadership \& Governance**
* Lead and develop the central AM team (Spare Parts Coordinator, CSD Head, Trade \& Services Marketing Manager, MIS Support) and regional team (Regional AM Heads, KAMs, Service Managers and Engineers)
* Provide input on Regional Aftermarket Heads' performance management (solid line to AM Head, dotted to Regional Business Heads)
* Run the governance cadence: weekly ops reviews, monthly regional P\&L calls, quarterly AM strategy reviews


**Pricing, Trade \& Commercial Excellence**
* Define AM pricing strategy – rack rates, scheme structures, contract pricing and promotional guardrails
* Lead trade scheme design, channel incentives and dealer performance tracking (via Trade \& Services Marketing Manager)
* Benchmark pricing and product portfolio against competitors periodically (via Trade \& Services Marketing Manager)
* Launch new AM products and own the conversion funnel


**Service Delivery \& Customer Experience**
* Hold accountability for customer NPS, first\-time\-fix rate and service SLA compliance (via CSD Head)
* Oversee spare parts availability, fill rates and dispatch SLAs (via Spare Parts Coordinator)
* Ensure complaint closure within SLA; build a service quality feedback loop into regional AM governance


**Capability Building**
* Build AM capability across the organization – technical training for SEs, commercial training for KAMs, commercial literacy for regional leadership
* Own MIS infrastructure (via MIS Support); ensure data\-driven performance management at all levels
* Develop a succession pipeline for critical AM roles across regions


**Skills \& Competencies**
**Technical \& Commercial Expertise**
* Aftermarket or industrial equipment domain expertise (capital goods / injection moulding preferred)
* Experience in B2B field sales and account management in capital goods or industrial equipment
* Channel economics, pricing strategy and margin management
* P\&L ownership across sales and service lines


**Analytics \& Planning**
* Data\-driven performance management with strong revenue forecasting capability
* Strategic roadmap development and governance planning
* Target setting, pipeline tracking and proficiency in MIS / BI tools


**Leadership**
* Cross\-functional leadership – ability to align Sales, Spares, Service and Supply Chain
* Executive and board\-level communication
* Team building across central and distributed regional teams


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of total experience, with at least 5–7 years in aftermarket, service or B2B industrial sales leadership roles
* Demonstrated P\&L ownership in capital goods, industrial equipment or allied sectors (e.g., compressors, machine tools, auto components, material handling)
* Proven track record of building and scaling aftermarket revenue including spares and service revenue streams
* Experience managing large, geographically distributed field teams (service engineers, sales managers)
* Exposure to channel/dealer networks and distributor management is a strong plus
* MBA or equivalent preferred; engineering background (Mechanical / Production) is advantageous


****Education****
********BE/BTech********
 (Preferebly Mechanical / Production)
 
 \&
 ****MBA****
 from TIER 1 Business School
   

  

**Deliverables \& KPIs**

* AM revenue vs. target
* Initiative\-delivery milestone closure
* IB penetration / service market share


**Service Quality**
* Customer NPS
* First\-time\-fix rate (%)
* Complaint closure within SLA (%)

**Diversity \- Innovation \- Caring \- Global Collaboration \- Winning Spirit \- High Performance**
 At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high\-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.
   

  

**Location:**
 Ahmedabad
   

  

**Job Description**
* Sells and promotes company products within a defined geographic territory by developing new accounts and expanding usage of company products by current accounts in an effort to meet a sales quota based on company sales goals and to directly increase sales revenue of the company.


**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Sells products by scheduling sales calls to meet with current and potential customers to fulfill revenue and unit growth objectives assigned by company on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.
* Develops and implements sales strategies by determining the relevant factors (e.g., product, competition and pricing needs) of existing and potential accounts to effectively promote the company's products to appropriate hospital personnel and physicians.
* Develops action plans (i.e., weekly, quarterly, monthly) by analyzing quarterly and monthly sales figures and reports identifying the needs of particular accounts and discussing issues with Regional Manager to help the organization achieve its annual sales goals.
* Determines the needs (e.g., product and pricing), goals, product usage, and types of cases handled by specific customers by meeting with and asking in\-depth questions of physicians and other hospital personnel to learn which Boston Scientific products can best address their specific needs.
* Observes actual procedures in the cardiac catheterization lab and operating room of hospital accounts to gain insight into the specific nuances of each physician and each member of the lab staff.
* Establishes pricing packages by working with relevant Boston Scientific personnel to establish price points that address specific customer's needs while satisfying company guidelines and policies.
* Responds to customer needs and complaints regarding products and service by developing creative and feasible solutions or working with other related personnel (e.g. clinical research, pricing and/or marketing) to develop optimal solutions.
* Develops relationships with hospital personnel (e.g. through casual conversation, meetings, participation in conferences) to make new contacts in other departments within hospital and to identify key purchasing decision makers in order to facilitate future sales.
* Educates customers on the merits and proper clinical usage of company products by giving presentations and demonstrations using a wide variety of formats and platforms (e.g., slides, transparencies, manuals) to secure purchasing commitments, often with the help of incentive programs and services made available to the account being developed.

title: Hubspot (Revops & Presales)
description:
**Company Description** 
 Mavlers is a global digital marketing and technology partner that supports organizations as a scalable, behind\-the\-scenes growth engine. With over 90,000 projects delivered by a team of 800\+ professionals across more than 52 countries, Mavlers collaborates with leading brands such as Disney, National Geographic, Incubeta, and Ogilvy. The company provides integrated services across CRM, MarTech, SEO, PPC, and Web Development, offering flexible teams that align with client workflows and business objectives. Mavlers focuses on co\-owning outcomes, helping clients expand services, onboard more customers, and achieve sustainable growth without the cost of large in\-house teams. Through thought leadership content, including the Marketing Insider Series and in\-depth blogs, Mavlers shares practical strategies and insights that drive measurable impact.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a part\-time remote role for a HubSpot (RevOps \& Presales) specialist at Mavlers. The role involves configuring and optimizing HubSpot CRM and associated RevOps processes, including pipeline setup, automation, reporting, and data hygiene to support sales and marketing alignment. The specialist will participate in presales activities such as requirement discovery, solution design, demos, and documentation that clearly communicate how HubSpot can address client needs. Day\-to\-day tasks include collaborating with internal teams and prospective clients, preparing proposals and scopes of work, creating playbooks and process documentation, and supporting onboarding and handover to delivery teams. The individual will also analyze performance metrics, recommend operational improvements, and contribute to best practices for HubSpot usage across client engagements.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret CRM data, optimize pipelines, and support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills for stakeholder collaboration, client presentations, and clear documentation.
* Candidates should possess Consulting capabilities to understand business processes, propose HubSpot\-based solutions, and guide RevOps improvements.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to manage client expectations, provide responsive support, and build long\-term relationships.
* Candidates should possess Presales experience, including discovery, solution mapping, demo preparation, and contributing to proposals.
* Hands\-on experience with HubSpot CRM, Marketing, and Sales hubs, including workflows, integrations, and reporting.
* Knowledge of revenue operations best practices across marketing, sales, and customer success functions.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage part\-time schedules, and prioritize multiple client requests.
* Experience in digital marketing, SaaS, or agency environments is preferred; certifications in HubSpot or RevOps are an advantage.

FSE is responsible for installation, maintenance and repair of the system with full technical background of the system, use of proper tools and understanding of the standard process.
   

  

 This position is part of the Commercial Department of LBS located in Ahmedabad and will be Remote. At Leica Biosystems, our vision is to advance cancer diagnostics and improve lives.
   

  

 You will be a part of the Service Team and report to the Regional Service Manager WEST who is responsible for achieving annual service strategies and goals through management of FSE’s \& Channel Partner Associates in indirect market, develop commercial programs and area service plans in close conjunction with the Service Excellence manager APAC to support and grow Leica Biosystems’ customers in West and AP/TL region.  Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
